parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.state, p.updated_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - p.updated_at)) as idle_seconds FROM projects p WHERE p.state NOT IN ('completed', 'delivered', 'learned', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND p.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.updated_at ASC
INSERT INTO system_health_logs (issues, stuck_projects, system_health, checked_at) VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, NOW()) RETURNING id

UPDATE projects SET state = 'stuck', updated_at = NOW(), error_log = error_log || jsonb_build_object('error', 'Project stuck - no activity for 30+ minutes', 'detected_at', NOW()) WHERE id = $1 AND state NOT IN ('completed', 'delivered', 'learned', 'failed', 'cancelled') RETURNING id, title, state
